item.text: The required Fortinet models and detection enums are already available in the module cache at a compatible go-cve-dictionary prerelease. I’ll update the pinned module to that version, then wire Fortinet through CPE filtering, confidence ranking, content conversion, advisory IDs, display priority, and both enrichment call sites.
